items.title: Scent Confidence and Premium Gifting Initiative
items.description: Focused investment to improve scent-led guided discovery, gift configuration, product confidence, and premium basket composition.

customerKPIs.expectedImpact: Increase confidence through clearer scent, product, routine, claim, review, and occasion guidance.
Improve promise visibility before gift orders are placed.

businessKPIs.expectedImpact: Increase conversion from guided discovery and gift builder sessions.
Increase premium basket quality with bundles, samples, and personalization.

productBricks.change: Improve scent, routine, occasion, and recipient recommendation logic.
Add deadline-aware gift builder, wrap, card, and recipient configuration.
Improve gift set and routine bundle assembly rules.
Add sample recommendations tied to gift and routine intent.

deliveryChannels.change: Release updated discovery and gift builder screens.
Release gift configuration and promise orchestration services.

items.title: Member Replenishment and Refill Initiative
items.description: Focused investment to improve member reorder timing, refill compatibility clarity, and consent-aware benefit personalization.

customerKPIs.expectedImpact: Increase timely reorders and refills before products run out.

businessKPIs.expectedImpact: Increase refill adoption among eligible products.

productBricks.change: Improve depletion prediction and reminder timing.
Improve refill compatibility, refill education, and packaging benefit logic.
Apply member benefits and reward messaging to replenishment moments.
Improve next-best-action decisions for reminders and offers.

deliveryChannels.change: Release refill and reorder surfaces to iOS.
Release refill and reorder surfaces to Android.
Release replenishment signals and decisioning updates.

items.title: Advisor Service and Store Execution Initiative
items.description: Focused investment to improve consultation note quality, advisor stock visibility, appointment handling, pickup readiness, and store task execution.

customerKPIs.expectedImpact: Increase customer trust in advisor recommendations.
Improve pickup reliability for omnichannel customers.

businessKPIs.expectedImpact: Increase store revenue influenced by assisted service.
Reduce failed pickup and endless-aisle promises.

productBricks.change: Improve consultation notes, recommendation save state, and follow-up context.
Improve appointment context, capacity, and outcome tracking.
Improve store stock and reservation visibility.
Add campaign and launch execution tasks with completion evidence.

deliveryChannels.change: Release advisor consultation and store task updates.
Release assisted checkout and stock recovery updates.

items.title: Launch and Claims Governance Initiative
items.description: Focused investment to improve product data quality, claim approval traceability, supplier evidence, and cross-market launch readiness.

customerKPIs.expectedImpact: Increase confidence that product setup, claim approvals, evidence, market restrictions, and store tasks are ready before launch.
Increase traceability from claims to formula, supplier, safety, refill, and packaging evidence.

businessKPIs.expectedImpact: Increase priority launches that reach first-sale date without material claim or product data defects.

customerKPIs.expectedImpact: Increase trust in ingredient, claim, refill, and usage information.

businessKPIs.expectedImpact: Increase repeat potential by reducing post-purchase claim and usage surprises.

customerKPIs.expectedImpact: Improve launch and campaign execution in boutiques.

businessKPIs.expectedImpact: Increase advisor confidence with new product launches.

productBricks.change: Improve launch readiness checks and market scope state.
Reduce product setup defects with stronger validation.
Add claim approval traceability and restriction checks.
Link sourcing evidence to launch gates and customer-facing claims.

deliveryChannels.change: Release product data validation and claim publication services.
Release approved product data exports for partners and franchise operators.
